summary: Design governed APIs and event-driven integrations across legacy and modern systems. Explore the course and plan your team’s next step.
lede: API integration architecture training helps enterprise architects, integration leads, and senior engineers design governed connections between established systems and digital products. Participants assess API portfolios and dependencies, design REST and event-driven contracts with OpenAPI and AsyncAPI, and apply security, versioning, and lifecycle governance. Exercises include mapping integration patterns, reviewing contracts, and developing a phased roadmap, with gateway operations and advanced implementation covered at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technology professionals who shape, deliver, or govern APIs and system integrations across enterprise environments.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with enterprise applications, software delivery, or system integration is recommended. No programming is required for the design and review exercises; coding and production configuration are outside the course scope.
